Captain Jean-Luc Picard, played by Patrick Stewart, does not appear in any episodes of "Star Trek: Voyager." While "Star Trek: Voyager" is part of the same universe as "Star Trek: The Next Generation," where Picard is a main character, he does not make any guest appearances in "Voyager."

Jean-Luc Picard appeared in the following episodes of Star Trek: Voyager, during the series crossover events. 

1. "Flashback" (Season 5, Episode 26) - Picard has a flashback, from 6 years before the main events of the show, of his crew's time on the USS Stargazer, just before the ship was destroyed, killing Picard and all hands on board.

Captain Jean-Luc Picard appeared in several episodes of Star Trek: Voyager, as a recurring character. Here are the exact episodes he appeared in:

1. **"Pathfinder" (Season 3, Episode 14)**
   In this episode, Captain Picard and Lieutenant Worf investigate a distress signal from a planet near the edge of Federation space.

2. **"The Pegasus" (Season 4, Episode 20)**
   This episode focuses on the search for the USS Pegasus, a ship that had been thought to have been destroyed. Captain Picard's encounter with the Pegasus serves as a central plot point.

3. **"The Chase" (Season 5, Episode 26)**
   In this episode, Captain Picard becomes infected with a symbiont that allows him to temporarily experience and see visions of humanity's ancestral past, including the early evolutionary history of the species.

4. **"Starship Mine" was cut and he was replaced in the rewritten script, however in the "Starship Mine II" this part was released later on, The Next Generation DVD  Season 6 episodes as an alternate version, but it is only available on DVD**

   However, Picard's appearances in Voyager were cut or removed from the regular TV show however he still appears in a brief and rewritten episode "Starship Mine"
